text: Owner review pass on kirchner.cv after the first live build: the document viewer is now exactly one page tall so the footer stays in reach, template text such as Curriculum Vitae is gone from the viewer and the generated PDF, Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Legal Notices pages were written for a personal CV site with no forms or trackers and linked from the footer, the Work section is reduced to the Madisonian separation-of-powers piece, every link to lawsofexistence.com is removed, and the header brand is the surname to match the domain.
